content: Mission Control replacement: no strong standalone macOS replacement; WMs that emulate workspaces (AeroSpace) make Mission Control nearly useless (hidden windows shown tiny) and recommend Group windows by application. rift and OmniWM ship their own overview. AeroSpace feature idea: show spaces side-by-side in Mission Control for overview; show the current tree. HN thread on Omacosy: users hate Space-switch animation, fullscreen breaking tiling, SIP requirements, unreliable daily weirdness.
